metricsEndpoint.title: Metrics collector address
metricsEndpoint.description: For example https://metrics.example.org (no trailing slash). When unset, metrics are only accumulated locally and exported by hand from the side panel.

metricsToken.title: Ingest token
metricsToken.description: Bearer token matching METRICS_TOKEN in the collector's .env file.

metricsEnabled.title: Whether usage metrics are collected
metricsEnabled.description: false disables metrics for every user in the organisation and the clinician cannot turn them back on. true does NOT lock anything — the user can still opt out themselves.
